mapper.select: SELECT s_value FROM settings WHERE s_key = #{sKey}
SELECT t_idx AS tpl_idx, t_title AS tpl_title, t_content AS tpl_content, DATE_FORMAT(t_created, '%Y-%m-%d') AS tpl_created FROM inquiry_template ORDER BY t_created DESC

SELECT l_idx AS alog_idx, a_idx AS adm_idx, a_name AS adm_name, l_action AS alog_action, l_detail AS alog_detail, l_ip AS alog_ip, DATE_FORMAT(l_created, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS alog_created FROM admin_log ORDER BY l_created DESC LIMIT #{numPerPage} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_log (a_idx, a_name, l_action, l_detail, l_ip) VALUES (#{admIdx}, #{admName}, #{alogAction}, #{alogDetail}, #{alogIp})
